fact: The National Education Sector Strategic Plan 2023-2027, published by the Ministry of Education in 2024, states that the Kenya Education Management Information System (KEMIS) will be put in place to hold individual information from birth to the completion of education, incorporating NEMIS, and its costed implementation matrix carries KEMIS lines in millions of Kenya shillings a year (a KEMIS data management system, KEMIS module enhancement and expansion, a policy institutionalising KEMIS); it also states that NEMIS has reached a 70% level of operationalisation and that primary and secondary learners have been registered on it. The matrix does not say whether the money is domestic.
title: National Education Sector Strategic Plan for the Period 2023 - 2027
